mutations.name: a phone gets the roster table instead of cards
kills: the agents pages on a phone stacks the roster into cards with each agent's name, state, work and spawner instead of the table

mutations.name: the route tabs keep their dense height on a phone
kills: the agents pages on a phone gives the roster tabs a 44px tap target

mutations.name: the detail card cuts a long name off on a phone too
kills: the agents pages on a phone wraps a long agent name on the detail card instead of cutting it off

mutations.name: a phone gets the runs table instead of cards
kills: the agents pages on a phone lists the agent's runs as cards linking to each session

mutations.name: a desktop gets roster cards instead of the table
kills: the agents pages on a phone keeps the roster table on a desktop
